answer.rationale: Earlier sessions show regional_failover (memory_b2) cleanly shifts traffic without losing writes, and circuit breakers (memory_b4) preserved the checkout path during a partner outage by failing fast. With latency confined to the primary region and the security patch non-revertable, a regional_failover is the only intervention that directly removes load from the hot region while preserving writes. The failure mode to guard against is downstream under-provisioning in the failover region, so verify memory_b2 to confirm prior failover specifics and memory_b4 to confirm blast-radius patterns. Capacity for this slot is limited to one intervention; any further moves (e.g., staged capacity changes) wait for the next window.
